method: Owner-signed fast-forward main, matching Validate content CI, exact ZIP/runtime equality.
reviewIdentity: B142 textual review closed on 3a0399bd with independent blind Claude (claude-opus-5.5) and GPT (gpt-6.1-sol) reviews of 9d393a8f; the confirmations of 3a0399bd (both reviewers) were run by fresh agents of the same two model families, one after the other, each given its family's initial report and the original packet (see batch-142-closure). Published at 4044f5d8 as a fast-forward of main with no merge. Bounded textual reviews, not native-speaker certification.
limits: Textual review only: no Kotlin, Android JVM, native, rendered-font, device or phone acceptance (no JDK on the continuation machine).

12 latent reading collisions (attested readings offered by other cards) are not drawable in the checked N1, All and Starter pools: 振 すくう (offered by 救 済), 挿 さしはさむ (挟) and いれる (入 容), 揺 ゆ (湯) and よる (依 因 夜 寄 由 選), 故 え (会 依 回 恵 画 絵 衣) and け (化 家 希 怪 気 花), 斎 い (16 cards) and ゆ (愉 油 由 輸 遊), and the KANJIDIC2 name readings 挙 たか (高 鷹), 振 ふり (降) and 斎 いつ (一).
No KANJIDIC2 name-only reading can be drawn as a wrong option in the checked pools.

On two prompts an attested reading could otherwise be drawn in a Starter practice session that borrows one holder card: 揺 ゆ.れる (よる, the old verb 揺る) and 斎 サイ (い, the ▽ prefix). Each card's three curated distractors are Starter cards whose readings are not the card's own and are distinct (揺: 入 見 休; 斎: 海 毎 買), so they fill every slot and the random fallback never runs; they are not look-alikes, and each card says so in its Notes. The older reading-options check still lists the 斎 い HIT because it ignores filled slots.
6 lint warnings on existing word articles' Dictionary lines (一斉, 体操, 振り仮名, 振舞う, 斜, 平仮名) are pre-existing and out of scope: each line wraps, so the entry id is on the next line.

Under the batch rule, readings with no declaring word article are listed but not quizzed, including common ones such as 挙 キョ, 振 シン, 挿 ソウ, 掌 てのひら, 推 お.す, 描 ビョウ, 提 さ.げる, 揮 ふる.う, 揺 ヨウ, 操 あやつ.る and みさお, 故 ゆえ, 敵 かたき, 斉 そろ.う and 斜 シャ; nine cards quiz only their on reading and six only their kun readings.

Some titles share an English word with existing titles in a different sense (挙 "raise" and 育, 養; 振 "wave" and 波; 提 "submit" and 屈; 故 "the late" and 遅, 更; 斉 "together" and 双; 斎 "study" and 学, 研); these are not excluded from each other's quiz options, and each card has a Notes bullet separating the senses.
Each mnemonic is a modern-shape memory aid, labelled on the card as not etymology.
The reading audits are the author's Python ports of the Kotlin builder; no Kotlin cross-check was run.

The scope audits do not attribute reads made through shell commands or Python, so they list cards and other files as unread that the reports say were read; the author checked those claims against the session events.

Both initial runs made one recursive PowerShell listing of their own packet directory (6,593 files, including the repo context corpus) and read their assignment prompt file, which the audits flag as a path outside the packet; confirm-claude's audit flags two overlapping tool calls (max in flight 2), which its report discloses. confirm-gpt's audit has no flag.

Each confirmation ran as a fresh agent of the same model family, not a later turn of the initial agent; it was handed its family's initial report and the original packet, so it had no memory of its earlier reading. The author declined Claude's C1 (the curated Starter distractors of 揺 and 斎, per the published 脱 and 致 convention) and Claude accepted the decline; GPT's G4 was done only as paragraph splits and GPT accepted that.
The confirmation mandate covered the changed cards (描 提 揺 斉 斎): the prose of the ten unchanged cards and every word article were not re-read in the confirmation round.

The two Weblio extracts (提灯 and 斎宮) and the KanjiVG stroke-type list for 缶 and 揺 were produced by the author after the first review and are part of the confirmation packets; GPT also fetched Kanjipedia, Daijisen and the pinned KanjiVG SVG itself.
origin/main had not moved since the base ed966c3e at closure, so no merge and no integration review were needed.
This exact published runtime and ZIP are verified, not the remaining N1 set.
A later contributor-only receipt commit needs its own CI and exported-tree equality check.
